reviews.name: Donna Moore Monroe
reviews.text:
STAR - gorgeous, playful, funny, rotten, precious, happy little dog — literally saved my heart when my Addie was killed.
She is show dog quality off of a Romanian Champion that Lydia planned to keep. But she so kindly let me have her because of my grief and nothing was available at the time, near Christmas. I will never forget her for that.

reviews.name: Kennlyn Forbes
reviews.text: I bought one years ago and she was the best. I lost her in April she was 14 and still cry every day she was like my child. I will definitely get another one from Lydia her babies are not only absolutely gorgeous but best personalities would not go to any other breeder she is absolutely the best

reviews.name: Karen Ferguson Withrow
reviews.text: Mandee came from Lydia and she's now 2 1/2! She keeps us entertained and busy! I know others who have purchased from Lydia and are just as happy with their pups as we are with our girl!

reviews.name: Tonya Renea Vossler
reviews.text: Tim and I bought Faith from Lydia in 2015. Faith has been a Blessing ever since. Lydia Moll is an exceptional lady. Lydia’s puppies are from the finest stock. The puppies Lydia has are so intelligent . The amount of training the new owner has to accomplish with the fur baby she purchases from Lydia is so small. Lydia’s puppies are dreams to have as part of the family.

reviews.name: Linda Barnes Hall
reviews.text: My Mickey is one of Lydia’s Maltese! If I ever get another Maltese it would be from Lydia. Her pups are beautiful, well socialized and extremely easy to train!

reviews.name: Jim Stockham Sr.
reviews.text: We have purchased three beautiful pups from Lydia since 2011. CJ was the 1st, (2011-2023) we adopted Saban in 2021 and Laci in 2024. We are big fans of her Korean lineage as these pups are absolutely GORGEOUS with smaller sizes, 5 lbs & under, beautiful thick coats, black points and small noses. All are AKC registered, and we got to meet the parents at her home. Her pups are wonderful and we highly recommend Lydia Moll/Chumaly Maltese. Would not purchase from anyone else. Harriet Stockham

reviews.name: Renee Leshman
reviews.text: My Mother Sheila Ruth Brey loved lydia as a person kind loving my mother from the Day she had her first furbaby in Oakpark Southfield Michigan she always was a fabulous elite ❤️ when it came to anything yet so down to earth she loved and loves animals she had Dobermans showed Sadie with a Top notch show Breeder had 2 Dobermans German Shepards two 2 mastiff Hungarian poolie a poodle she groomed them beautiful feed them the best and went to the finest breeders researched she gave each tender loving care and later in life was taken to ohio she loved through a friend and it was different the internet she met susan Lynn my mothers life changed but no matter what she had the utmost class and loved her furbabys she met lydia she loved maltese and lydia truly makes sure she gives hrr puppies to the finest loving people I am telling you lydia found my mother to be the most loving owner truly my mother said out of all her breeders through out her life she was so greatful for susan Lynn she had just lost two maltese and about 5vyrs later got Paisley ❤️ they spent 8 yrs together my mother just loved her they slept together hand feed her took her everywhere if she wasnt home she had to have a family member me with her I just closed her but my mother was in love with her lydia is wonderful

reviews.name: Carmen Sissy Stewart Bedwell
reviews.text: My little Allie Bama has been a joy. She was born on February 2, 2020. I still can’t believe she is already 6. She goes to work with me. She is the smallest of all the dogs there…5 of them….and she puts them all in their place. It is very funny. One wants to play and she lets her know she doesn’t want to play. Allie was a great choice for me. Thanks Lydia.

reviews.name: Maria-Elena Schneider
reviews.text: A year ago, Little Kai Meeko came into our lives after the tragic loss of our Little Mateo. He’s brought so much joy, laughter and happiness to us, including to our 7 year old Maltese. Lilly had stopped playing and was very sad, as we all were. Meeko brought her back to life, and us! They play, chase each other and steel each other’s toys! We have fallen completely in love with him and can’t imagine our lives without him. Today Meeko is 2 years old and we are celebrating with special treats, meals and new toys
